about: A C# library that reads and edits Outlook .msg email files without needing Outlook.

prs.title: Saving a message after removing an attachment works again
prs.broken: Removing an attachment from an email file and saving it crashed with an error, after a library update made saving stricter.
prs.changed: The library now finishes writing its changes before it tidies up the file.
prs.matters: Apps can strip attachments from saved emails again without crashing.
